WITH total_cost AS (
  SELECT SUM(T1.`cost`) AS total
  FROM expense AS T1
  JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.`link_to_budget` = T2.`budget_id`
  JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.`link_to_event` = T3.`event_id`
  WHERE T1.`cost` IS NOT NULL
),
yearly_kickoff_cost AS (
  SELECT SUM(T1.`cost`) AS event_total
  FROM expense AS T1
  JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.`link_to_budget` = T2.`budget_id`
  JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.`link_to_event` = T3.`event_id`
  WHERE T3.`event_name` = 'Yearly Kickoff'
  AND T1.`cost` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  (event_total * 100.0 / total) AS percentage_cost
FROM total_cost, yearly_kickoff_cost

SELECT M.first_name, M.last_name, T.total_paid
FROM member AS M
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT T1.link_to_member, SUM(T1.cost) AS total_paid
    FROM expense AS T1
    INNER JOIN budget AS T2
    ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id
    WHERE T1.link_to_member IN (
        SELECT T3.link_to_member
        FROM expense AS T3
        INNER JOIN budget AS T4
        ON T3.link_to_budget = T4.budget_id
        GROUP BY T3.link_to_member
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T4.link_to_event) > 1
    )
    GROUP BY T1.link_to_member
    ORDER BY total_paid DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS T
ON M.member_id = T.link_to_member

INNER JOIN event AS Ev ON B.link_to_event = Ev.event_id
